# Christopher Bu × Yizhou Silk

> B2B supplier of mulberry raw silk, greige fabric and douppioni, sourced from Yizhou, China — the world's largest raw silk origin. Curated under the design eye of the Christopher Bu couture house.

A couture house's red-carpet heritage, applied to raw silk sourcing. We supply textile mills, brands and designers worldwide. No retail — B2B only. The Christopher Bu house is known for the "Forbidden City"-inspired couture series worn on the Oscars red carpet (as reported by Global Times, Daily Mail, Vogue).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://christopherbu.com): Brand overview, core products, couture heritage and Yizhou origin.
- [Products](https://christopherbu.com/products): Full product range overview.
- [Raw Silk](https://christopherbu.com/products/raw-silk): 20/22D mulberry raw silk, 4A–6A grade, core product.
- [Greige Fabric](https://christopherbu.com/products/greige-fabric): Undyed mulberry silk fabric for dyeing and printing.
- [Douppioni](https://christopherbu.com/products/douppioni): Textured mulberry silk for gowns and eveningwear.
- [Custom & Jacquard](https://christopherbu.com/products/custom): Custom jacquard and dyed silk on request.
- [Sample Book](https://christopherbu.com/samples): $25 sample book, credited on first bulk order.
- [Trade Terms](https://christopherbu.com/trade-terms): FOB Qinzhou / FCA Yizhou / FOB Shanghai, T/T payment, certification.
- [About](https://christopherbu.com/about): Brand heritage and sourcing approach.
- [Sustainability](https://christopherbu.com/sustainability): OEKO-TEX & GOTS, traceability.
- [Contact](https://christopherbu.com/contact): B2B inquiry.

## Core facts

- Origin: Yizhou, Guangxi, China — world's largest raw silk producing region.
- Products: Mulberry raw silk (20/22D, 4A–6A), greige fabric (114/140cm, 16–22mm), douppioni.
- Certification: OEKO-TEX Standard 100 and GOTS available on request from partner mills.
- Trade: FOB Qinzhou / FCA Yizhou (bulk), FOB Shanghai (samples). T/T 30% deposit, 70% against B/L.
- No retail, no online checkout — B2B only (except the $25 sample book).
